text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option b 15.0 to 15.8 s. First framing to 15.2 with the car drifting left and tilting. At 15.4 cut to a second overhead framing with a different bank: oak crown and pale ledge at upper left, car smaller at right on the water edge. By 15.6 to 15.8 the car moves up-left into the current, rotates and grows, foam at its rear and thin curved wake lines behind it. Stripes remain thick and edge to edge. A faint short curved mark in the upper water at 15.2 and a short curved stroke near the right end of the upper stripe at 15.6 are visible. No dark shadow beneath the car is clearly distinguishable in these samples. Crown clear of the chip; car above caption.
